title: survival on incus runtime (in-container claude)

acceptance_scenarios.intent: For incus-container workspaces, ptyhost holds the `incus exec -t` wrapper (argv assembled by palmux2 via PTYCommander); in-container claude survives palmux2 restart at the same pid.
acceptance_scenarios.test_kind: REAL-MACHINE SURVIVAL smoke on a real incus host (deploy-test isolated-throwaway method)
steps: Assert (unit/integration) that palmux2 builds the full `incus exec -t <inst> --user … --cwd … --env … -- /abs/claude <args>` argv (existing PTYCommand output) and passes it OPAQUELY to the ptyhost launcher — ptyhost holds no claude/incus knowledge.

Real-incus smoke: use the deploy-test isolated-throwaway method (project_deploytest_isolated_smoke) — a SEPARATE config-dir, defaultRuntime=incus-container, a throwaway repo, and a dev-prefix instance so the managed palmux2 and existing containers are never disturbed.

Start the throwaway dev palmux2 under a systemd --user transient unit; open a claude-tui tab in an incus workspace → ptyhost holds the incus-exec wrapper; record the ptyhost pid (host) AND the in-container claude pid (`incus exec <inst> -- pgrep -f claude`).
Restart the dev palmux2 unit (`systemctl --user restart` / re-serve). Assert: ptyhost host pid unchanged AND in-container claude pid unchanged (same pid) after restart.
Reconnect and assert the TUI screen restores (ties AC-2-2) with the in-container session intact.
Full cleanup: delete throwaway instance, repo, config-dir. Confirm managed palmux2 + pre-existing containers untouched.
If no real incus host is reachable under autopilot, escalate at milestone (priority_rule 0 [SURVIVAL]); do NOT mark done from host-only reasoning.
acceptance_scenarios.expected: In-container claude keeps its pid across palmux2 restart; screen restores. SURVIVAL_PASS on real incus.

acceptance_scenarios.intent: SHUTDOWN reaps the in-container claude (KillContainerProcesses-equivalent) so no claude lingers in the container (S4d8b1c reap backlog).
steps: On a SHUTDOWN of a ptyhost holding an incus wrapper, assert palmux2-side GC invokes the in-container reap (runtime.ContainerProcessKiller.KillContainerProcesses TERM→KILL matching the container claude bin) — per design §8 the reap is palmux2-side, not baked into the generic ptyhost.
Assert killing only the host-side `incus exec` wrapper is NOT sufficient and the explicit in-container pkill runs.
Real-incus: after SHUTDOWN (tab delete / orphan GC), assert `incus exec <inst> -- pgrep -f claude` returns NO match (no residual claude).
Assert pkill exit code 1 (no match) is treated as success, not error.
acceptance_scenarios.expected: After SHUTDOWN the container has zero residual claude processes.

notes: Because palmux2 already assembles the incus-exec argv (existing PTYCommand path in daemon.spawnWithArgs), the ptyhost side needs no incus awareness — it just holds the process (ADR-0002). Reuse the existing runtime.ContainerProcessKiller (incus.KillContainerProcesses) for the reap; wire it into the SHUTDOWN/GC path on the palmux2 side (Story 3's orphan-GC + tab-delete). Touches daemon.go (incus arg path stays), manager.go + store GC (SHUTDOWN → reap), reuses incus.go KillContainerProcesses. Coupled with Story 3's SHUTDOWN path — hence serialized after it.
